content.short: Host.tg is a Telegram event-management app for creating, organizing, and managing events from chat.
content.description: Host.tg brings event management into Telegram for communities that want to organize activities without switching to a separate platform. Users can create events, manage attendance, coordinate meetups or campaigns, and handle ticketing flows directly inside the Telegram experience. It fits social and community coordination better than a generic productivity or calendar tool because event participation is the core user action.
